partes.label: Parte 1
partes.subtitle: Preguntas personales
partes.objetivo: Responder directo + dar 1-2 detalles + cerrar limpio. Sin silencios. Sin enrollarte: aquí no toca discurso largo.

pasos.title: Respuesta directa + ejemplo personal
pasos.grammar: Presente simple para hábitos, presente continuo para situaciones actuales
pasos.template: Yes, I do, actually. I usually [verbo + complemento] because [razón]. For example, [detalle personal concreto].

opciones: go to the gym after work
spend time with my family on Sundays
go for a walk in the park

huecos.tipo: Razón (acaba con phrasal verb para subir nivel)
opciones: it helps me clear my mind
last weekend I went hiking with friends
yesterday I cooked pasta for my family
this morning I went for a run before work

pasos.trick: Termina la razón con un phrasal verb o expresión idiomática: 'unwind', 'switch off', 'recharge my batteries', 'clear my mind'. Sube nivel al instante.

pasos.title: Cierre con valoración
pasos.grammar: Frase corta y limpia. NO termines a medias
pasos.template: It's [adjetivo B2] for me, and honestly, I wouldn't change it.
pasos.trick: No uses 'good' ni 'nice' aquí. Quedan A2. Usa 'essential', 'rewarding', 'refreshing'.
pasos.warning: No termines la respuesta a medias. Usa esta frase corta como cierre.

tecnologia.pregunta: Do you use technology every day?
tecnologia.respuesta: Yes, I do, actually. I usually check my phone first thing in the morning because it helps me stay organised and I find it really useful. For example, yesterday I used a translation app to chat with a tourist in the street. It's essential for me, and honestly, I wouldn't change it.

redes.respuesta: Yes, I do, actually. I usually check Instagram after work because it helps me unwind and I find it relaxing. For example, last weekend I shared a few pictures of a trip with my friends. It's enjoyable for me, and honestly, I wouldn't change it.

trabajo.pregunta: Do you ever work from home?
trabajo.respuesta: Yes, I do, actually. I usually work from home two days a week because it helps me focus and I find it really productive. For example, last Friday I finished a long report without any interruptions. It's rewarding for me, and honestly, I wouldn't change it.

educacion.respuesta: Yes, I do, actually. I usually study English in the evenings because it keeps me focused and I find it really stimulating. For example, last week I started a new online course on grammar. It's fulfilling for me, and honestly, I wouldn't change it.

medioambiente.pregunta: Do you do anything to protect the environment?
medioambiente.respuesta: Yes, I do, actually. I usually recycle at home because it helps me feel responsible and I find it really worthwhile. For example, last weekend I took some old clothes to a charity shop. It's meaningful for me, and honestly, I wouldn't change it.

viajes.respuesta: Yes, I do, actually. I usually travel abroad at least once a year because it helps me broaden my horizons and I find it really inspiring. For example, last summer I went to Italy with my family. It's rewarding for me, and honestly, I wouldn't change it.

salud.pregunta: Do you take care of your health?
salud.respuesta: Yes, I do, actually. I usually go for a run three times a week because it helps me clear my mind and I find it really refreshing. For example, this morning I went jogging before breakfast. It's essential for me, and honestly, I wouldn't change it.

familia.pregunta: Do you spend a lot of time with your family?
familia.respuesta: Yes, I do, actually. I usually have lunch with my family on Sundays because it helps me catch up with them and I find it really comforting. For example, last Sunday we had a homemade paella together. It's meaningful for me, and honestly, I wouldn't change it.

partes.label: Parte 2
partes.subtitle: Describir una foto + 2 preguntas
partes.objetivo: Describir la foto con orden fijo (qué/dónde/quién/sensación/suposición) y luego responder 2 preguntas usando estructura O-P-E-E-C.

pasos.title: Descripción de la foto
pasos.grammar: Presente continuo para describir (are + verb-ing), there is/are para localizar
pasos.template: In this picture, I can see [número + sujeto + acción en -ing] in [lugar]. They are [ropa/aspecto] and the atmosphere looks [adjetivo de ambiente]. They seem [sentimiento], and it looks like [suposición]. In my opinion, this picture [valoración].

opciones: a group of teenagers using their phones

huecos.tipo: Qué supones que pasa (con 'it looks like')
opciones: they're working on a joint project
captures a typical scene of modern life
reflects how we spend our free time

pasos.trick: El verbo 'seem' + 'it looks like' son ORO. Demuestran que sabes especular sin afirmar. Es estructura B2 puro.
pasos.warning: 'There is two people' → ERROR. Correcto: 'There are two people'. Plural obligatorio. No hagas listas sin conectar.

pasos.title: Responder pregunta asociada (×2)
pasos.grammar: Estructura O-P-E-E-C: Opinión + Punto + Ejemplo + Explicación + Cierre
pasos.template: From my point of view, [opinión clara]. For example, in my case, I [ejemplo personal en presente]. This means that [consecuencia]. All in all, [cierre].

opciones: it's something we should make time for
it has a big impact on how we feel
make a point of seeing my family every week
spend time outdoors as often as I can
it really takes a load off my mind

pasos.trick: Mete una expresión idiomática en el ejemplo: 'it really takes a load off my mind', 'it brings out the best in me', 'it's a no-brainer'.

tecnologia.pregunta: Foto: gente usando ordenadores en una oficina moderna
tecnologia.respuesta: In this picture, I can see three colleagues working on their laptops in a modern office. They are dressed in smart casual clothes and the atmosphere looks bright and welcoming. They seem focused, and it looks like they're working on a joint project. In my opinion, this picture captures a typical scene of modern professional life with technology.

redes.pregunta: Foto: dos amigos mirando el móvil
redes.respuesta: In this picture, I can see two friends looking at a phone in a cosy café. They are dressed in casual clothes and the atmosphere looks lively. They seem engaged, and it looks like they're scrolling through social media together. In my opinion, this picture reflects how we share moments online nowadays.

trabajo.pregunta: Foto: persona trabajando desde casa con un portátil
trabajo.respuesta: In this picture, I can see a person working on a laptop in a cosy living room. They are dressed in casual clothes and the atmosphere looks peaceful and quiet. They seem focused, and it looks like they're in the middle of a remote meeting. In my opinion, this picture captures a typical scene of working from home.

educacion.respuesta: In this picture, I can see a group of students taking notes in a classroom. They are dressed in casual clothes and the atmosphere looks focused and quiet. They seem engaged, and it looks like they're listening to a lecture. In my opinion, this picture reflects the importance of education in our lives.

medioambiente.pregunta: Foto: gente reciclando o plantando árboles
medioambiente.respuesta: In this picture, I can see a group of volunteers planting trees in a park. They are dressed in sportswear and the atmosphere looks lively and warm. They seem cheerful, and it looks like they're taking part in an environmental initiative. In my opinion, this picture shows the importance of caring for our planet.

viajes.pregunta: Foto: turistas haciendo fotos en un sitio famoso
viajes.respuesta: In this picture, I can see a couple of tourists taking pictures in front of a famous landmark. They are dressed in casual clothes and the atmosphere looks bright and lively. They seem cheerful, and it looks like they're enjoying a weekend break. In my opinion, this picture captures the joy of discovering new places.

salud.pregunta: Foto: gente haciendo deporte en un parque
salud.respuesta: In this picture, I can see a group of people running in a park. They are dressed in sportswear and the atmosphere looks bright and energetic. They seem focused, and it looks like they're training for a race. In my opinion, this picture reflects how we take care of our health nowadays.

familia.respuesta: In this picture, I can see a family having dinner around a table. They are dressed in casual clothes and the atmosphere looks warm and homely. They seem cheerful, and it looks like they're celebrating something. In my opinion, this picture captures the importance of spending quality time with family.

partes.label: Parte 3
partes.subtitle: Comparar 2 fotos + 2 preguntas
partes.objetivo: Comparar y contrastar las dos fotos, identificar similitudes y diferencias, y dar opinión razonada. Aquí la máquina puntúa MUCHO la variedad gramatical.

pasos.title: Apertura comparativa
pasos.template: At first sight, both pictures show situations related to [tema general], but in completely different contexts. Let me take a closer look at each of them.

huecos.tipo: Tema común a las dos fotos

pasos.trick: Aperturas alternativas: 'Straight away, I can tell that both pictures...' / 'From the very first glance, I notice that...'

pasos.title: Similitudes
pasos.grammar: Both + verbo plural, Both of them + are + -ing
pasos.template: Both pictures show [acción/elemento común], and in both of them, the people seem [sentimiento común].
pasos.trick: Si no encuentras una similitud obvia, basta con decir 'people interacting' o 'people enjoying their time'.

pasos.title: Diferencias (lo más importante)
pasos.grammar: Conectores de contraste: whereas, while, on the other hand, however
pasos.template: However, the main difference is that in the first picture [detalle foto 1], whereas in the second one [detalle foto 2]. Another clear difference is [segunda diferencia].

opciones: several colleagues are interacting in an office
the setting is indoors and formal
a person is working alone from home
the setting is outdoors and relaxed
people are interacting face to face

pasos.trick: 'Whereas' > 'while' > 'but'. Cuanto más arriba en la lista, más nivel demuestras. Memoriza 'whereas' y úsalo sí o sí.

pasos.title: Opinión personal con preferencia
pasos.grammar: Condicional segundo: If I had to choose, I would prefer...
pasos.template: If I had to choose, I would personally lean towards [foto 1 / foto 2], because [razón sólida]. It's far more [adjetivo comparativo] for someone like me.

opciones: it fits the way I work

pasos.trick: 'Lean towards' es phrasal verb B2 (= inclinarse por). Mucho más sofisticado que 'prefer'. Memorízalo.
pasos.warning: 'If I would choose, I would...' → ERROR. Correcto: 'If I had to choose, I would...'. Condicional 2 lleva past simple en la condición.

tecnologia.pregunta: Fotos: 1) gente con libros · 2) gente con tablets/ordenadores
tecnologia.respuesta: At first sight, both pictures show situations related to learning, but in completely different contexts. Both pictures show people engaged in study, and in both of them the people seem focused. However, the main difference is that in the first picture students are reading printed books, whereas in the second one they're using digital devices. If I had to choose, I would personally lean towards the second option, because it gives me more flexibility. It's far more convenient for someone like me.

redes.pregunta: Fotos: 1) gente charlando cara a cara · 2) gente chateando por móvil
redes.respuesta: At first sight, both pictures show situations related to communication, but in completely different contexts. Both pictures show people interacting, and in both of them they seem engaged. However, the main difference is that in the first picture friends are talking face to face, whereas in the second one they're chatting through their phones. If I had to choose, I would personally lean towards the first option, because face-to-face contact feels more genuine. It's far more meaningful for someone like me.

Both pictures show people engaged in their professional tasks, and in both of them they seem focused. If I had to choose, I would personally lean towards working from home, because it gives me more flexibility. It's far more convenient for someone like me.

Both pictures show students learning, and in both of them they seem focused. However, the main difference is that in the first picture students are sitting in a traditional classroom, whereas in the second one they're studying through a screen at home. If I had to choose, I would personally lean towards the traditional setting, because human contact really matters in learning. It's far more rewarding for someone like me.

Both pictures show landscapes shaped by human activity, and in both of them we can see the impact we have. However, the main difference is that in the first picture there's heavy traffic and pollution, whereas in the second one nature is untouched. If I had to choose, I would personally lean towards the second option, because being in nature recharges my batteries. It's far more refreshing for someone like me.

Both pictures show people enjoying a new place, and in both of them they seem cheerful. However, the main difference is that in the first picture people are training in a gym, whereas in the second one they're running outdoors. If I had to choose, I would personally lean towards the second option, because being outside clears my mind. It's far more refreshing for someone like me.

familia.respuesta: At first sight, both pictures show situations related to family life, but in completely different contexts. Both pictures show a family at the table, and in both of them they're together. However, the main difference is that in the first picture everyone is chatting and making eye contact, whereas in the second one each member is absorbed in their phone. If I had to choose, I would personally lean towards the first option, because quality time is what really brings families closer. It's far more meaningful for someone like me.

partes.label: Parte 4
partes.subtitle: Tema abstracto + 3 preguntas
partes.objetivo: Hablar 2 minutos completos sin quedarte en blanco. Variedad gramatical (presente, pasado, futuro, condicional). Aquí es donde más puntos te juegas para B2.

pasos.title: Introducción · romper el hielo
pasos.template: It's widely recognised that [tema] has become increasingly relevant in modern society. From my point of view, these kinds of situations are very common nowadays, especially in our fast-paced world.
pasos.trick: 'It's widely recognised that...' es pasiva impersonal B2/C1. Suena académico, sube nota cualitativa al instante.

pasos.title: Opinión + razonamiento (Punto 1)
pasos.grammar: Presente simple + futuro + linkers de adición
pasos.template: There's no denying that [tema] has transformed the way we [verbo]. One of the main advantages is that it helps us [verbo + complemento]. What's more, more and more people are [verbo + -ing] these days.

opciones: stay connected with our loved ones

pasos.trick: 'helps us SAVE' (sin 'to'). 'More and more' es comparativo progresivo B2 puro.

pasos.title: Contraargumento (Punto 2)
pasos.template: However, [tema] also has some drawbacks, such as [problema 1] or [problema 2]. Although it's generally beneficial, we shouldn't overlook the fact that [matiz negativo].

opciones: its long-term effects are still unclear
it requires a lot of self-discipline

pasos.trick: 'Overlook' > 'forget'. Y 'we shouldn't overlook the fact that...' es B2 puro.
pasos.warning: Tras 'such as' solo sustantivos o gerundios, NUNCA infinitivos.

pasos.title: Experiencia personal (storytelling rápido)
pasos.grammar: Pasado simple + pasado continuo · VARIEDAD GRAMATICAL clave
pasos.template: This reminds me of the time when I [pasado simple]. I remember once [pasado continuo + detalle], and I learnt that [lección].

opciones: decided to disconnect from social media for a week
I was scrolling through Instagram when I realised I'd wasted three hours
I was working overtime and felt completely drained
I was preparing for an exam late at night

pasos.trick: Mezclar pasado simple y pasado continuo en la misma frase = demostración instantánea de control gramatical B2.

pasos.title: Hipótesis y futuro
pasos.template: If I were in this situation, I would probably [acción condicional]. In the future, I think people will [acción futura], especially due to [causa].

opciones: look for a better work-life balance

pasos.trick: Usa 'were' con todos los sujetos en condicional 2 ('If I WERE'). Más B2 que 'was'.
pasos.warning: 'If I am in this situation, I will...' → ERROR. Para hipótesis usa condicional 2: 'If I were in this situation, I would...'.

pasos.title: Cierre con idiom B2/C1
pasos.template: In a nutshell, [tema] is a double-edged sword: we just need to find the right balance. All things considered, it's here to stay, and we just need to learn how to use it wisely.
pasos.trick: Tres idioms en una frase: 'in a nutshell' + 'double-edged sword' + 'here to stay'. Memorízalos como bloques.

tecnologia.pregunta: How has technology changed our lives?
tecnologia.respuesta: It's widely recognised that technology has become increasingly relevant in modern society. From my point of view, these kinds of situations are very common nowadays, especially in our fast-paced world. There's no denying that technology has transformed the way we communicate. One of the main advantages is that it helps us save time and effort in our daily tasks. What's more, more and more people are working remotely these days. However, technology also has some drawbacks, such as addiction or loss of focus. Although it's generally beneficial, we shouldn't overlook the fact that its long-term effects on mental health are still unclear. This reminds me of the time when I decided to switch off my phone for a whole weekend. I remember once I was working late at night and felt completely drained, and I learnt that balance is essential. If I were in this situation, I would probably set clearer boundaries with screens. In the future, I think people will rely more on technology, especially due to technological advances. In a nutshell, technology is a double-edged sword: we just need to find the right balance.

redes.pregunta: What do you think about social media?
redes.respuesta: It's widely recognised that social media has become increasingly relevant in modern society. From my point of view, these kinds of situations are very common nowadays, especially in our fast-paced world. There's no denying that social media has transformed the way we communicate. One of the main advantages is that it helps us stay connected with our loved ones. What's more, more and more people are using these platforms to share ideas these days. However, social media also has some drawbacks, such as addiction or lack of privacy. Although it's generally beneficial, we shouldn't overlook the fact that its long-term effects on mental health are still unclear. This reminds me of the time when I decided to disconnect from Instagram for a week. I remember once I was scrolling through my feed and realised I'd wasted nearly three hours, and I learnt that balance is essential. If I were in this situation, I would probably set clearer boundaries with screen time. In the future, I think people will become more selective about what they consume online, especially due to growing awareness of mental health. In a nutshell, social media is a double-edged sword: we just need to find the right balance.

trabajo.pregunta: Is working from home a good thing?
trabajo.respuesta: It's widely recognised that working from home has become increasingly relevant in modern society. From my point of view, these kinds of situations are very common nowadays, especially in our fast-paced world. There's no denying that remote work has transformed the way we work. One of the main advantages is that it helps us save time on commuting. What's more, more and more people are looking for flexible jobs these days. However, working from home also has some drawbacks, such as social isolation or burnout. Although it's generally beneficial, we shouldn't overlook the fact that it requires a lot of self-discipline. This reminds me of the time when I worked remotely for a whole month. I remember once I was working overtime and felt completely drained, and I learnt that setting limits matters. If I were in this situation, I would probably look for a healthier balance. In the future, I think people will look for a better work-life balance, especially due to shifting cultural values. In a nutshell, working from home is a double-edged sword: we just need to find the right balance.

educacion.respuesta: It's widely recognised that education has become increasingly relevant in modern society. From my point of view, these kinds of situations are very common nowadays, especially in our fast-paced world. There's no denying that education has transformed the way we learn. One of the main advantages is that it helps us develop new skills. What's more, more and more people are studying online these days. However, education also has some drawbacks, such as high costs or lack of equal access. Although it's generally beneficial, we shouldn't overlook the fact that not everyone has the same opportunities. This reminds me of the time when I started a new online course. I remember once I was studying late at night and felt completely exhausted, and I learnt that preparation makes all the difference. If I were in this situation, I would probably look for a healthier balance. In the future, I think people will rely more on online learning, especially due to technological advances. In a nutshell, education is a double-edged sword: we just need to find the right balance.

medioambiente.respuesta: It's widely recognised that climate change has become increasingly relevant in modern society. From my point of view, these kinds of situations are very common nowadays, especially in our fast-paced world. There's no denying that human activity has transformed the way the planet behaves. One of the main advantages of being eco-friendly is that it helps us protect future generations. What's more, more and more people are choosing sustainable options these days. However, sustainable living also has some drawbacks, such as higher prices or limited availability. Although it's generally beneficial, we shouldn't overlook the fact that it requires a lot of self-discipline. This reminds me of the time when I decided to reduce my plastic use. I remember once I was shopping and noticed everything was wrapped in plastic, and I learnt that small changes really add up. If I were in this situation, I would probably look for a different approach. In the future, I think people will rely more on renewable energy, especially due to growing awareness. In a nutshell, climate change is a challenge we all share: we just need to find the right balance.

viajes.pregunta: Why do people travel so much these days?
viajes.respuesta: It's widely recognised that travelling has become increasingly relevant in modern society. From my point of view, these kinds of situations are very common nowadays, especially in our fast-paced world. There's no denying that travelling has transformed the way we see the world. One of the main advantages is that it helps us broaden our horizons. What's more, more and more people are exploring new countries these days. However, travelling also has some drawbacks, such as high costs or environmental impact. Although it's generally beneficial, we shouldn't overlook the fact that mass tourism damages local communities. This reminds me of the time when I travelled to Italy with my family. I remember once I was visiting a small town and felt completely amazed, and I learnt that travelling really opens your mind. If I were in this situation, I would probably try a more sustainable approach. In the future, I think people will choose more eco-friendly trips, especially due to climate change. In a nutshell, travelling is a double-edged sword: we just need to find the right balance.

salud.pregunta: How can we lead a healthier life?
salud.respuesta: It's widely recognised that health has become increasingly relevant in modern society. From my point of view, these kinds of situations are very common nowadays, especially in our fast-paced world. There's no denying that lifestyle has transformed the way we feel. One of the main advantages of taking care of yourself is that it helps us reduce our stress levels. What's more, more and more people are doing exercise regularly these days. However, our modern lifestyle also has some drawbacks, such as burnout or sedentary habits. Although awareness is generally positive, we shouldn't overlook the fact that it requires a lot of self-discipline. This reminds me of the time when I took up running. I remember once I was running in the park and felt completely energised, and I learnt that small habits really make a difference. If I were in this situation, I would probably look for a healthier balance. In the future, I think people will spend more time outdoors, especially due to growing health awareness. In a nutshell, health is a double-edged sword: we just need to find the right balance.

familia.pregunta: How important is family in today's society?
familia.respuesta: It's widely recognised that family life has become increasingly relevant in modern society. From my point of view, these kinds of situations are very common nowadays, especially in our fast-paced world. There's no denying that modern routines have transformed the way we relate to our family. One of the main advantages of close family bonds is that it helps us reduce our stress levels. What's more, more and more people are valuing quality time these days. However, modern family life also has some drawbacks, such as lack of time or distance between members. Although family is generally a positive force, we shouldn't overlook the fact that not everyone has a supportive environment. This reminds me of the time when I moved away from home. I remember once I was having a video call with my parents and realised how much I missed them, and I learnt that family really matters. If I were in this situation, I would probably set time aside every week. In the future, I think people will look for a better work-life balance, especially due to shifting cultural values. In a nutshell, family life is a treasure: we just need to find the right balance.

estrategia.title: Habla todo el tiempo
estrategia.body: La máquina penaliza los silencios y las respuestas cortas. Si te sobra tiempo, repite la idea principal con otras palabras. Mejor enrollarse que callarse.

estrategia.title: Variedad gramatical
estrategia.body: Presente + pasado + futuro + condicional. Si solo usas presente, tu nota baja. La Parte 4 es donde más debes mostrar variedad.

estrategia.title: Conectores siempre
estrategia.body: However, whereas, although, despite, consequently, as a result. Una frase de cada bloque debe llevar un conector. Sin excepciones.

estrategia.title: Frases-comodín de rescate
estrategia.body: 'Let me think...', 'What I mean is...', 'To put it another way...' te salvan cuando te bloqueas. Tenlas memorizadas.

estrategia.title: Idioms y phrasal verbs
estrategia.body: Mete al menos uno por respuesta larga: lean towards, end up feeling, in a nutshell, bear in mind, double-edged sword.

estrategia.title: No te corrijas en voz alta
estrategia.body: Si te equivocas, sigue. 'Sorry, I mean...' está bien una vez, pero no abuses. La máquina valora fluidez, no perfección.
